theme: switch engines sorting freight cars into outbound trains
title: Humpyard Radix Resort
strategies: single-bucket dig baseline: dump every car onto one classification track, then dig each needed car out one car at a time with a scratch-and-restore shuffle (reproduces the checker baseline, ~O(N^2) single-car moves)

textbook LSD radix passes: recognize the Y classification tracks as digit buckets on key = train_id*L + slot, run ceil(log_Y N) distribute/collect passes -- but every move is a single car on a single engine (pays full per-move overhead every time, switches mode ~2D times)

batched radix + engine choreography: same radix passes, but collect each bucket back as ONE cut (not N singleton pops) and assemble each finished train as ONE cut, while engine 1 is dedicated to every distribute-type move and engine 2 to every collect-type move so neither ever pays the mode-switch penalty
seeded local search over move batching / engine assignment on top of the radix skeleton
